snippet.title: Horses of Hoofprint Bay - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Horses of Hoofprint Bay, a 2D point-and-click barn-building game developed by Thogli Studios. Players will tend to the horses' needs, manage staff, and compete to build out the stable of dreams. Horses of Hoofprint Bay is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
